title: Home timeline missing remote/federated posts
description: smallhold's /api/v1/timelines/home endpoint only returns local posts. Remote posts delivered to the inbox are stored in remote_posts table but not included in the home timeline query. The public timeline also doesn't include them. Need to JOIN remote_posts for followed accounts into the timeline query.
close_reason: Fixed: home timeline now includes remote posts from followed accounts via UNION query on remote_posts JOIN remote_accounts.
